item.title: Por qué Netflix dice que nadie ha ganado la guerra del streaming y cómo piensa competir con YouTube
item.description: Ted Sarandos considera que la guerra del streaming está lejos de terminar. Netflix enfrenta el avance de YouTube, el auge de los videos cortos y la irrupción de contenidos generados con inteligencia a ...
item.dc:creator: Sohee Kim, Emily Chang
item.content:encoded: Bloomberg — El co-CEO de Netflix Inc. ( NFLX ), Ted Sarandos, considera que la guerra de los servicios de streaming está lejos de haber terminado, a pesar de que el sector que él mismo ayudó a crear está entrando ahora en una fase más madura y competitiva. “Nadie ha ganado la guerra del streaming”, afirmó Sarandos durante una entrevista en el programa The Circuit de Bloomberg, presentado por Emily Chang. “La guerra del streaming sigue en marcha”. Con menos de la mitad del tiempo dedicado a ver la televisión en EE.UU. destinado a servicios como el suyo, “todavía estamos en las primeras fases de todo esto”, señaló. Esto significa que Netflix debe prepararse para una batalla muy diferente a la que comenzó. La empresa se ha convertido en el servicio de transmisión por pago dominante a nivel global, aunque el crecimiento de la participación de los espectadores se ha desacelerado, justo cuando YouTube acapara una parte cada vez mayor del tiempo que los estadounidenses pasan frente al televisor. Ver más: Mafalda llega a Netflix en 2027: la llamada de cinco minutos de Campanella que dio origen a la serie De acuerdo con Nielsen, YouTube logró una cuota récord del 15,8% del consumo televisivo en EE.UU. en agosto, lo que supone casi el doble de la cuota de Netflix. La compañía está respondiendo con una reestructuración de tanto su plantilla como del propio servicio. Netflix ha llevado a cabo recientemente su mayor ronda de despidos en años y ha sustituido a dos de sus ejecutivos de más alto rango, entre ellos la directora de contenidos, Bela Bajaria. Sarandos describió la reestructuración como un “reajuste” con el objetivo de hacer que la empresa sea “más sólida de cara al futuro”. “Existen personas que son buenas para el negocio en una etapa determinada, pero que pueden no serlo en la siguiente”, explicó. “Y uno quiere adelantarse a eso en la medida de lo posible”. A medida que Netflix y el sector del streaming han madurado, señaló, la capacidad de la empresa para producir éxitos de forma constante ha cobrado mayor importancia. Esto es especialmente cierto en su mercado nacional. “Deberíamos estar obteniendo mejores resultados en EE.UU. de lo que hemos logrado hasta ahora”, afirmó Sarandos. “Tenemos que centrarnos de verdad en nuestra capacidad para lograrlo”. Netflix está ampliando su definición de entretenimiento mientras busca nuevas maneras de mantener el interés de sus aproximadamente 325 millones de suscriptores. Ha profundizado en los eventos en directo y los deportes, ha experimentado con programación dirigida por creadores y con podcasts, y está dando a algunas de sus películas más importantes un estreno en salas más amplio. Entre ellas se encuentra una secuela de KPop Demon Hunters , la película más taquillera de la su historia. Sarandos ha afirmado que está convencido de que la nueva película “tendrá un gran éxito en las salas y también en Netflix”, lo que supone un cambio notable para una empresa que durante años se resistió a los estrenos cinematográficos tradicionales. Ver más: Los usuarios de Netflix ven menos contenidos y abren la aplicación con menos frecuencia Netflix también tiene previsto ampliar los estrenos en salas de cine de otras películas importantes, como Narnia: The Magician’s Nephew , en un intento por llegar al público tanto dentro como fuera de la aplicación. Esta medida se produce en un momento en el que Netflix se enfrenta a una competencia cada vez más intensa por captar la atención de los espectadores en múltiples frentes, desde YouTube y los videos de formato corto hasta una ola inminente de contenidos generados por la inteligencia artificial. Sarandos afirmó que la ventaja de Netflix en un mercado cada vez más saturado es la ambición de su narrativa. “Lo que distingue a Netflix de cualquier otra plataforma, incluidos los servicios gratuitos financiados con publicidad, las redes sociales y los sitios de intercambio de archivos, es la ambición narrativa”, afirmó. “No creo que podamos competir mejor en ese aspecto persiguiendo todo aquello en lo que la gente dedica casualmente cinco segundos de su tiempo frente a la televisión”. Ver más: Netflix recurrió a IA y al “mayor” bluescreen de Latinoamérica para recrear impacto de Otis en ‘Contra el huracán’ A medida que la IA facilita la producción de un volumen enorme de contenido de video, Sarandos prevé que el público buscará “una narrativa más ambiciosa y mejor elaborada en un mundo inundado de basura”. Al mismo tiempo, Netflix está adoptando la tecnología que subyace a esa disrupción. Sarandos comparó la llegada de la inteligencia artificial generativa con la transición de la animación desde las imágenes dibujadas a mano hasta los gráficos por computadora. “El salto de la animación 2D dibujada a mano a los gráficos generados por computadora (CG, por sus siglas en inglés) que tenemos hoy, es mucho mayor que el salto de los gráficos generados por computadora a la IA”, afirmó. “Y, no obstante, el sector de la animación nunca ha sido tan grande ni ha dado empleo a tanta gente”. La inteligencia artificial por sí sola no sustituirá a los trabajadores creativos, señaló, aunque “alguien que la use mejor que usted sí podría hacerlo”. Lea más en Bloomberg.com

item.title: イランの脅威「大幅増大」、国内外の米国人にリスク＝国家情報長官
item.description: [ワシントン １８日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
[ワシントン １８日 ロイター] -  クレイトン米国家情報長官は１８日、議会下院国土安全保障委員会の公聴会で、イランの米国人に対する脅威が大幅に高まっていると述べた。

クレイトン氏はで「国内外でイランによる殺害を目的とした陰謀を検知し、抑止し、対処することに引き続き全力を尽くしている」とし、「こうした脅威は大幅に増大している。国内外の米国人はこれまで以上に大きな脅威にさらされている」と述べた。

イランは現在も続く米軍の攻撃に対する報復として米軍や地域の同盟国を攻撃すると警告。ロイターが先月確認したメモによると、クレイトン氏は、イランが米国人職員を標的とする活動を強化しており、イランによる米国人に対する殺害計画は「高度な段階」に達していると指摘していた。

こうした中、米ＣＮＮは今週に入り、イランが米首都ワシントンで放射性物質を飛散させる「ダーティーボム（汚い爆弾）」による攻撃を計画している可能性があると米情報機関の情報として報道。クレイトン氏は公聴会でこの報道について質問された際、個別事案への言及は避け、民間人に対する大量破壊の脅威は長年にわたり存在していると述べるにとどめた。

item.title: アンソロピック株オプション、早ければ23日に取引開始へ 旺盛な需要見込む
item.description:
Laura Matthews
[ニューヨーク １８日 ロイター] - 人工知能（ＡＩ）開発企業アンソロピック株のオプシ...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
アンソロピック株オプション、早ければ23日に取引開始へ　旺盛な需要見込む 3:22 配信

米アンソロピックのロゴ。11月10日撮影。REUTERS/Dado Ruvic（ロイター） Laura Matthews

[ニューヨーク １８日 ロイター] - 人工知能（ＡＩ）開発企業アンソロピック株のオプション取引が、早ければ２３日にも開始される可能性がある。市場関係者が旺盛な需要を見込む中、同社の先行きに賭ける新たな手段になるとみられる。

取引所運営会社Ｃｂｏｅグローバル・マーケッツは、業界の準備状況次第では、株式の取引開始から２営業日後にオプション取引を上場する見通しだ。同社のデリバティブ部門グローバル責任者、ロブ・ホッキング氏は「アンソロピックの新規株式公開（ＩＰＯ）は新たな起爆剤となり、オプション市場に新しい投資家層と取引を呼び込む可能性がある」とし、「オプションによってリスクをどのように管理できるかをより多くの人々が理解し、投資家教育がこの成長をけん引しているのを見るのは素晴らしいことだ。このトレンドは今後も続くと予想している」と述べた。

オプションメトリックスのギャレット・デシモーネ氏は「アンソロピックのオプションが上場すれば、相当な関心が集まると予想している」と指摘。「ＡＩを巡る熱狂と、ＩＰＯに典型的な宝くじのようなリターンプロファイルが相まって、即座に投資家を惹きつけるだろう。ＡＩに最も純度の高い形で集中投資できる対象の一つとして、株価は非常に変動しやすくなる可能性も高い」との見方を示した。

アンソロピックは、１８日にＩＰＯの公開価格を決定する見通しで、株式は１９日にナスダックで取引が始まる。

FAST

NEW YORK, Nov 18 : Texas has resumed issuing air permits for data centers, state regulators said on Wednesday, after pausing the practice last month as part of the state's broader attempt to manage the server warehouses and their effects on the electrical grid, communities and the environment. • The Texas Commission on Environmental Quality "has resumed its normal permit review process and will evaluate applications under all applicable state and federal laws and regulations," TCEQ spokesperson Laura Lopez said. • Texas Governor Greg Abbott halted the connection of new data centers to the state electric grid in August and ordered an audit of the projects, rattling one of the world's fastest-growing hubs for data center development. Abbott followed up by temporarily blocking air permits for all data center projects. • The air permit resumption came after the Texas grid operator notified the TCEQ that it had collected "community impact review" information for proposed data center projects, Lopez said.

• Abbott, a Republican, lost his reelection bid in this month's midterm elections to Democratic challenger Gina Hinojosa, who has promised to impose a moratorium on data centers once in office in January. • The most recent permitting decision may generate more pushback from incoming Texas Democratic lawmakers and politicians in the new year, analysts said. • "TD Cowen sees Abbott's lame duck permitting push as likely to strengthen the Dem-stakeholder demand that Hinojosa take a firm stand, reducing hopes for a near-term policy agreement between Hinojosa and data center developers," the firm said in a note.

Source: Reuters

PARIS, Nov 18 : Crypto exchange Binance said it had secured a court order from Abu Dhabi Global Markets – its main financial regulator – as part of its efforts to recover funds which were frozen after hackers stole $6.3 billion worth of crypto last month. Binance has previously said that around $2.85 billion worth of the stolen crypto tokens had been frozen or intercepted by third parties after the hack. “We will continue using every lawful tool available to trace, freeze and recover stolen assets, support our partners in returning funds where possible, and keep those assets out of the hands of the attackers,” Dugan Bliss, deputy general counsel at Binance, said in a statement on Wednesday.

Source: Reuters

item.title: Nvidia raises sales outlook, says business can thrive without Huang
item.description: Nvidia raised its next fiscal year's revenue growth forecast to 75% and announced a $150 billion stock buyback expansion as interim CEO Colette Kress sought to reassure investors.
item.dc:creator: Bloomberg
item.content:encoded: Nvidia Corp sought to deliver a clear message during its first earnings update since the departure of longtime leader Jensen Huang: He is not coming back, and the company will be fine without him. The chip giant boosted its sales forecast for next year and vowed to improve its access to critical supplies, while tamping down speculation that Huang might return. The company also added $150 billion to its stock buyback programme. Investors initially applauded the news, sending the stock up as much as 5.4 per cent at one point. It later dipped into the red on alternative trading platform Blue Ocean. “Our supply is growing, our customers and our partners are with us, and employees are committed,” interim Chief Executive Officer Colette Kress said during a conference call with analysts on Tuesday. “We’ve got this.” It was a high-stakes moment for Kress, who took the reins last week after Huang’s ouster — a chaotic exit reportedly spurred by multiple extramarital affairs and concerns that he was targeted by a Chinese espionage plot. Nvidia has been the largest beneficiary of the artificial intelligence (AI) build-out, and Huang served as the industry’s biggest cheerleader. Now the company looks to ensure that its momentum will not be undermined by the controversy swirling around it. Revenue will grow 75 per cent in the next fiscal year, Nvidia said, up from a previous forecast of 70 per cent. Sales will be $130 billion in the fiscal fourth quarter, plus or minus 3 per cent. Analysts had estimated $125.3 billion on average. “It’s business as usual,” said Kress, who has been Nvidia’s chief financial officer for more than a decade. “We’ve engaged with our customers. We’ve engaged with our suppliers, our partners. They’re all 100 per cent behind us.” Nvidia has embarked on a search for a new permanent CEO. During the call, Chairman Harvey Jones dismissed the idea that Huang might return. “The Nvidia board unanimously accepted his resignation and does not intend to reinstate Jensen as CEO,” he said, adding that executive search firm Heidrick & Struggles had been enlisted to find a new leader. Nvidia also said it would no longer ship its licensed Hopper data centre products to China, although the company had been allowed to offer those older-generation components under US export rules. At the firm's data centre division — its biggest source of revenue — sales more than doubled to $107.6 billion in the third quarter, which ended October 25. Total sales rose 103 per cent to $115.8 billion in the same period. Meanwhile, China's military is seeking advanced Nvidia chips for AI-enabled weapons as Chinese-made processors continue to lag US rivals, a congressional commission said in its annual report released on Wednesday.

item.title: エヌビディア株2％超下落、好業績見通しも経営混乱への懸念続く
item.description:
Anhata Rooprai Shashwat Chauhan
[１８日 ロイター] - １８日の米株式市場で、エヌビ...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
エヌビディア株2％超下落、好業績見通しも経営混乱への懸念続く 2:26 配信

2025年1月27日に撮影　REUTERS/Dado Ruvic/Illustration/File Photo（ロイター） Anhata Rooprai　Shashwat Chauhan

[１８日 ロイター] - １８日の米株式市場で、エヌビディア株が取引開始前の上昇から一転、２％超下落し、人工知能（ＡＩ）関連株の一角を押し下げた。前日発表された好業績見通しを受けた当初の安心感が薄れる一方、共同創業者ジェンスン・フアン氏の突然の退任に伴う不透明感が続いている。

エヌビディア株は取引開始前に一時３％上昇したが、午前の市場では２％以上下落した。このまま取引を終えれば、時価総額は８００億ドル余り減少する見通し。

１０月に付けた最高値から１７日の終値までに、既に約２兆ドルが失われている。

カウンターポイントの調査担当バイスプレジデント、ニール・シャー氏は「昨日の決算は投資家心理を安定させ、最近のＡＩ関連株の売りに歯止めをかけたと考えている。ただ、投資家の不安を根本的に解消したのではなく、先送りしたにすぎない」と述べた。

エヌビディアでは最高経営責任者（ＣＥＯ）の選定と独立調査が続いているほか、米証券取引委員会（ＳＥＣ）も同社を調査していると米紙ウォール・ストリート・ジャーナルが報じており、ＡＩ関連株全体の投資家心理を圧迫している。

エヌビディアのハーベイ・ジョーンズ会長は、フアン氏復帰の可能性を否定した。人材紹介会社ハイドリック・アンド・ストラグルズが、社内外の候補から正式なＣＥＯを選ぶ作業を主導している。

ＨＳＢＣのアナリストは、正式なＣＥＯが決まり、新経営陣が計画通りに製品を投入できると示すまでは、株価の一段の上昇は難しい可能性があると指摘した。

エヌビディアは１７日、２０２７年度第４・四半期（２０２６年１１月─２７年１月）の売上高が市場予想を上回るとの見通しを示した。第３・四半期（８─１０月）の売上高も前年の２倍超となり市場予想を上回った。

NEW YORK, Nov 18 : Options on Anthropic shares could begin trading as soon as Monday, giving investors a new way to wager on the AI company's prospects as market participants expect heavy interest. Cboe Global Markets expects to list the contracts two business days after the stock begins trading, pending industry readiness. “The Anthropic IPO could be yet another catalyst, bringing a new wave of investors and trading activity to the options market," said Rob Hocking, Cboe’s global head of derivatives. "It’s great to see investor education driving this growth, as more people learn how options let them define their risk. An exciting trend and one we expect to continue.”  The Claude developer is expected to price its IPO later on Wednesday, and the shares will begin trading on the Nasdaq on Thursday.   "We expect significant interest in Anthropic options once they list," said Garrett DeSimone, head quant at OptionMetrics. "The combination of AI-driven enthusiasm and the lottery-like payoff profile typical of IPOs are likely to draw investors immediately. As one of the most concentrated pure-play exposures to AI, the stock is also likely to be highly volatile."

Interest in Anthropic options could exceed the interest in SpaceX options earlier this year, said Ophir Gottlieb, chief executive of Capital Market Laboratories, citing oversubscription that is pushing the company's valuation higher and could invite various positioning ahead of the deal, as well as the market backdrop. "The AI trade is melting down," Gottlieb said. "Many feel it is overdone, while many others feel it's the popping of a bubble. Whenever there is such opposing views in a heated market, we get a lot of option positioning." Options give holders the right, but not the obligation, to buy or sell shares at a set price within a certain period. They offer investors a cheaper way to gain exposure to a stock and to express their views on both short-term price moves and longer-term positioning. Anthropic’s $64 billion IPO has drawn stronger early institutional demand than the offering of SpaceX, with the book six times oversubscribed last week, Reuters previously reported. The IPO has drawn anticipation from investors, with Wall Street rolling out products tied to the stock, hosting client events and giving away merchandise ahead of the AI company's potentially record launch.

Source: Reuters

item.description: Nov 18 : While the causes of recent disruptions to the way people work, access bank accounts and travel remain unclear, increased efforts to rapidly patch newly discovered vulnerabilities in the AI age are likely a major factor, according to cybersecurity experts and US officials.US Secretary of State Marco R

Patching in the AI age may underlie some of the major tech outages, experts say

FAST

Nov 18 : While the causes of recent disruptions to the way people work, access bank accounts and travel remain unclear, increased efforts to rapidly patch newly discovered vulnerabilities in the AI age are likely a major factor, according to cybersecurity experts and US officials. US Secretary of State Marco Rubio, speaking to reporters in Manila this week, said company patching efforts are, at times, "creating short-term disruption in the way the system works." Patches are software and operating system updates intended to fix security vulnerabilities found within a program or product. The advent of easily accessible AI tools and large language models has supercharged the discovery of vulnerabilities in software. Microsoft this month has addressed more than 1,200 software vulnerabilities, nearly 20 times higher than in the same month a year ago, according to cybersecurity firm Qualys.

"AI has made finding critical vulnerabilities fast and cheap, and the number of flaws that demand immediate patching has grown with it," said Yuval Itzchakov, CTO and co-founder of autonomous offensive security company A Security.  "Emergency patches go into core infrastructure within hours, often without the full testing cycle, and they are intrusive by design: they change runtimes, kernels and network components that everything else depends on. That speed and scale of change is itself a source of failure," Itzchakov said. Josh Bressers, director of coordinated vulnerability disclosure at cybersecurity firm VulnCheck, said that in 2026 there have been 100,000 publicly disclosed vulnerabilities, tracked by industry as Common Vulnerabilities and Exposures, or CVEs. Of those, Bressers said, 1,363 were known to have been exploited in the real world.  "Given tight resources for defenders, understanding which vulnerabilities need attention first is critical," Bressers wrote in a LinkedIn post. "Not all vulnerabilities are created equal." Anne Neuberger, general partner at Andreessen Horowitz, said that AI is helping attackers find and weaponize vulnerabilities, but is a more "valuable friend" to those tasked with defending key computer networks. "AI is enabling enterprises to find 10 times more vulnerabilities," said Neuberger, who served as deputy national security adviser under former President Joe Biden and led incident response to serious national incidents. "And when patching at scale, some can cause problems."

Source: Reuters

item.title: トランプ氏、プーチン氏と19日個別会談 ＡＰＥＣ開催中＝当局者
item.description: [ワシントン １８日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
[ワシントン １８日 ロイター] - トランプ米大統領は１９日、アジア太平洋経済協力会議（ＡＰＥＣ）首脳会議が開催されている中国で、ロシアのプーチン大統領と個別会談を行う見通し。米ロ両国の当局者が１８日明らかにした。

米当局者は会談の予定を確認しつつも、それ以上の詳細には踏み込まなかった。

１９日には中国の習近平国家主席も交えた米中ロ首脳会談も予定されている。

ロシアのインタファクス通信によると、ロシアのペスコフ大統領報道官は、１９日に予定される米ロ首脳会談で本格的な交渉は行われないだろうとの認識を示した。また、ロシアのウシャコフ大統領補佐官（外交担当）によると、米ロ会談はAPEC首脳会議の本会合後に開かれ、両国代表団の数人が出席する見通しという。

item.title: EE.UU. alerta sobre ciberataques iraníes a infraestructura crítica desde el inicio de la guerra
item.description: Funcionarios de EE.UU. afirmaron que Irán y grupos respaldados por Teherán han atacado redes de transporte, energía, servicios financieros y agua desde el inicio del conflicto.
item.dc:creator: Myles Miller, Ellen Milligan
item.content:encoded: Bloomberg — Funcionarios de la administración Trump afirmaron que los ciberataques iraníes han tenido como objetivo la infraestructura y las redes críticas de Estados Unidos desde que comenzó la guerra a principios de este año, pero recalcaron que las recientes interrupciones tecnológicas y la paralización de los vuelos de aviones estadounidenses no guardaban relación alguna con estos hechos. El gobierno iraní y los agentes respaldados por Teherán han atacado los sistemas estadounidenses de transporte, servicios financieros, energía, atención médica y agua, declaró el secretario de Seguridad Nacional, Markwayne Mullin, en un testimonio escrito previo a la audiencia anual del Congreso sobre amenazas mundiales que se celebrará el miércoles. Pero Mullin no afirmó que las recientes interrupciones en los servicios que afectaron desde los bancos comerciales hasta la Agencia de Seguridad Nacional se debieran a ciberataques iraníes. Ver más: Irán amenaza con tomar represalias contra objetivos civiles si EE.UU. hace lo mismo “Los ciberdelincuentes del gobierno iraní y los cibercriminales proiraníes han atacado las redes de infraestructura crítica de Estados Unidos desde que comenzó el conflicto con Irán a principios de este año”, dijo Mullin en su discurso preparado. En la misma audiencia, Jay Clayton, director de inteligencia nacional de Estados Unidos, amplió las declaraciones del secretario de Estado Marco Rubio el martes por la noche, en las que afirmaba que una reciente serie de fallos tecnológicos y la interrupción de los vuelos de aeronaves estadounidenses por parte de la Administración Federal de Aviación no estaban relacionadas con ciberataques iraníes. “Se trata de interrupciones del servicio aisladas, relacionadas con tareas de mantenimiento y cambios técnicos”, declaró Clayton en la audiencia. “No son un ataque coordinado ni patrocinado por el Estado”. Si bien Mullin afirmó que los ataques iraníes “históricamente han producido efectos localizados y mínimamente perjudiciales contra instalaciones industriales con escasa seguridad”, advirtió que “los sistemas vulnerables y la deficiente higiene cibernética en la infraestructura vital podrían generar consecuencias perjudiciales”. Ver más: ¿Qué es una bomba sucia? EE.UU. investiga posibles planes de Irán para atacar a funcionarios de Trump El subdirector del FBI, Christopher Raia, también afirmó que la agencia no ha encontrado pruebas de que la actividad cibernética maliciosa haya causado los fallos recientes, a pesar de que los equipos de ciberseguridad han participado en las investigaciones “desde el primer día”. “Hasta el momento, no existe ningún indicio de que haya habido actividad cibernética maliciosa relacionada con ninguno de esos incidentes”, dijo Raia. Estas declaraciones se producen casi nueve meses después del inicio de la guerra contra Irán del presidente Donald Trump, que comenzó el 28 de febrero. El vicepresidente JD Vance atribuyó en parte a la guerra la derrota republicana en las elecciones de mitad de mandato de Estados Unidos el 3 de noviembre. Ver más: Trump dice que EE.UU. investiga un posible plan de Irán para atacar a funcionarios en Washington D.C. Si bien Trump afirmó recientemente que la guerra estaba “prácticamente terminada” y que ya había sido “ganada”, el conflicto se ha intensificado recientemente con ataques estadounidenses contra plataformas de lanzamiento de misiles, ataques iraníes contra Bahréin y un número creciente de ataques contra buques comerciales en el Golfo Pérsico. Raia afirmó que la agencia ha desarticulado en los últimos años múltiples complots iraníes dirigidos contra funcionarios y activistas estadounidenses que viven en el país. En una declaración escrita aparte, presentada antes de la audiencia, Raia afirmó que Irán, Corea del Norte y Rusia están actualmente involucrados en ciberespionaje contra Estados Unidos y en esfuerzos continuos para establecer puntos de apoyo en la infraestructura crítica estadounidense que podrían ser explotados durante una futura crisis o conflicto. En su testimonio posterior, Clayton se negó a comentar sobre un reciente informe de CNN que indicaba que Irán está desarrollando planes para atacar a altos funcionarios del gobierno estadounidense con una bomba sucia, y afirmó que no divulgaría detalles de inteligencia. Declaró que Irán posee una “red muy sofisticada y global que debemos combatir con seriedad, utilizando todas las herramientas a nuestro alcance”. Lea más en Bloomberg.com

item.title: How the Anthropic IPO stacks up against SpaceX
item.description: The Anthropic IPO is expected to price on Wednesday. The AI lab stands to be the second-biggest U.S. initial offering on record, after SpaceX’s record IPO in June.
item.dc:creator: Reuters Staff
item.content:encoded: The Anthropic IPO is expected to price on Wednesday. What are would-be buyers getting? The AI lab stands to be the second-biggest U.S. initial offering on record, after SpaceX’s record IPO in June. And like SpaceX, an Elon Musk company that sends rockets into space and develops AI models, valuations look stretched, if not quite to the same degree. At the US$1.4 trillion valuation that has been bandied about by bankers in recent weeks, Anthropic would trade at 40 times its sales over the last 12 months. When SpaceX went public at a roughly US$1.8 trillion valuation, it carried a multiple of roughly 92 times revenue in the previous 12 months. That is many times the multiples that other big AI players trade at. Amazon trades at 3.5 times its trailing 12 months sales and Alphabet at 7.3 times, according to LSEG data. But growth is one of the scarcest values in the market and there are signs that once again investors will be willing to pay up. Institutional demand has been strong, Reuters has reported, and in an echo of the SpaceX offering, retail traders are rushing to get shares - even if many analysts and portfolio managers are skeptical. “We wouldn’t be a buyer at this level. We’ll look for drawdowns post the debut and see what we find,” said Tom Hulick, CEO at Strategy Asset Managers, whose firm has some indirect exposure to Anthropic through a growth equity fund. Shares of AI-linked companies have been pressured in recent months by concerns about whether investments are paying off in increased productivity. Rising interest rates are making projects costlier and harder to finance, while the prospect of increased government regulation is hitting sentiment. Add to that the mixed performance of IPOs over the years, especially large ones at high valuations, and there is some doubt about what will happen when Anthropic hits the market on Thursday. “This is the single fastest-growing company of all time. It’s like investing in the stock of Michael Jordan when he’s just starting out,” said Eric Schiffer, chairman of The Patriarch Organization, a Los Angeles-based family office. “But newly-listed companies are volatile in the early stages. And that’s not going to be any different here.” Structural issues could pressure early performance. Anthropic’s IPO lock-up provisions allow certain employees and insiders to sell portions of their holdings from the first trading day, with further staggered releases tied to earnings announcements. Co-founders, who own a total 10 per cent stake, can transfer up to 29 per cent of their holdings after 180 days, with the rest unlocking after a year. By comparison, SpaceX’s lock-up structure was more restrictive for CEO Elon Musk, who owned just under half of the company and is barred from selling his shares for a year, with no early-release provisions. SpaceX’s shares are trading above their IPO price but below the price they opened at in June. How Anthropic’s shares trade could shape the outlook for other blockbuster IPOs, especially rival OpenAI’s, which is expected to go public as soon as next year. “Where the rubber meets the road is the first earnings after the IPO. That’s where you oftentimes see companies fall back,” said Edward Best, co-Chair, capital markets at Willkie Farr & Gallagher. --- Reporting by Niket Nishant in Bengaluru; Writing by Sruthi Shankar; Editing by Colin Barr and Arun Koyyur

Nov 18 : South Africa will be without number eight Jasper Wiese for the remainder of the Nations Championship after the 31-year-old was handed a four-week suspension on Wednesday following his red card during the Springbok's 21-19 defeat by France last week. • Wiese was given a 20-minute red after his yellow card was upgraded by the bunker review system for a dangerous clear-out at a ruck. • The forward will miss Saturday's fixture against Ireland - Wiese was left out of the South Africa side selected - and the Nations Championship finals weekend. • Wiese will have his suspension reduced to three weeks, should he undertake the World Rugby Coaching Intervention Programme.

item.title: 米で相次ぐシステム障害、「組織的・国家関与の攻撃ではない」＝国家情報長官
item.description: [ワシントン １８日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
[ワシントン １８日 ロイター] - クレイトン米国家情報長官は１８日、米国で相次ぐシステム障害は、組織的または国家が関与する攻撃ではないとの考えを示した。

クレイトン氏は下院国土安全保障委員会の公聴会で、「これらの事案が起きたタイミングが疑問を招く可能性があることは理解している。実際にそうあるべきであり、米国民はわれわれにこうした問いを投げかけるべきだ」と指摘。その上で「だが、入念な調査を経て現時点で把握している情報に基づけば、これらは保守作業や技術的な変更に伴う個別のサービス障害だ」とし、「これらは組織的ないし国家が関与する攻撃ではない」と述べた。

クレイトン氏はその上で「イランからの脅威は大幅に増大している」との見方も示した。

FAST

Nov 18 : All eyes will be on Lionel Messi and Inter Miami when Major League Soccer's playoffs kick off this week as they look to become the first back-to-back MLS Cup champions in nearly 15 years. Miami’s regular season was not the smoothest, with coaching changes and a dismal record at home, but Messi has proven time after time that he cannot be counted out, even at the age of 39. The Argentine won a second consecutive Golden Boot this year with 26 goals, adding 17 assists, and could become the first player to win three straight MLS MVP awards. That is not to say Cristian 'Kily' Gonzalez’s side are a one-man show, with Uruguayan striker Luis Suarez, who notched 17 goals this season, and Brazilian midfielder Casemiro also headlining a talented team that finished second in the Eastern Conference.

But if Miami are to become the league’s first repeat champions since the LA Galaxy won back-to-back titles in 2011 and 2012, they will need some more magic from Messi, who guided them to their first MLS Cup last year with six goals and nine assists. Miami open their title defence at home against the Columbus Crew on Saturday. The month-long MLS postseason begins with wild-card matches on Thursday, with Orlando City SC hosting FC Cincinnati and the Seattle Sounders welcoming Real Salt Lake. RED-HOT NASHVILLE Standing in the way of Miami’s quest for glory are Eastern Conference rivals Nashville SC, who will hope to cap off their brilliant year with a historic first MLS Cup. The well-rounded side set the MLS single-season points record with 77 on the way to claiming the Supporters’ Shield as the team with the best regular-season record. Led by midfielder Hany Mukhtar and forward Sam Surridge, who combined for 38 goals this season, they also went unbeaten at home.   Still, B.J. Callaghan’s squad will need to overcome one more thing to claim the title: superstition. Over the past 14 seasons, only two teams who claimed the Supporters’ Shield went on to win the MLS Cup. Nashville begin their postseason campaign on Sunday against the winner between Orlando City and Cincinnati. ICE-COOL VANCOUVER In the Western Conference, the top-seeded Vancouver Whitecaps will look to return to the MLS Cup final and avenge last year’s heartbreaking 3-1 loss to Miami. Jesper Sorensen’s side are coming off a historic season that saw them claim their first-ever Western Conference regular-season title, setting a handful of club records along the way, including most wins (19), most points (64) and most goals scored (74). The midseason departure of standout American midfielder Sebastian Berhalter could still be a blow in the postseason for the Whitecaps, who will also need Thomas Mueller to stay fully fit if they want to finish the job this time around.  The Whitecaps will play either the Sounders or Real Salt Lake on Sunday.

Source: Reuters

item.title: 高級品市場、26年に不振脱却の兆し 長期はなお不透明感＝ベイン
item.description:
Elisa Anzolin
[ミラノ １８日 ロイター] - コンサルティング会社ベイン・アンド・カンパニーは１８日...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
高級品市場、26年に不振脱却の兆し　長期はなお不透明感＝ベイン 0:51 配信

イタリア・ミラノの「ガレリア・ヴィットーリオ・エマヌエーレ２世」で1月12日撮影。REUTERS/Daniele Mascolo（ロイター） Elisa Anzolin

[ミラノ　１８日　ロイター] - コンサルティング会社ベイン・アンド・カンパニーは１８日、２０２６年の個人向け高級品市場はここ２年程度の不振から脱却する兆しがあるとの見通しを明らかにした。ただ、長期的にはなお不透明感が残ると指摘した。

世界の個人向け高級品の２６年の売上高は、現在の為替レートで前年比約２％増の３６７０億ユーロ（約４０３０億ドル）と見込む。過去１５年間の年平均増加率５％を下回る見通しだ。２７年は、横ばいから４％程度の増加の間になると予測している。

ベインは、２７年も米州が引き続きけん引すると予想する一方、新型コロナウイルス禍前に好調だった中国は、不振が続くと見込む。欧州は、中東情勢により混乱した観光客の回復に伴い、安定化すると見ている。

顧客基盤は２５年の３億３０００万人から、２６年には３億１５００万人に減少すると推定。消費性向が旅行や高級ダイニングなどにシフトしていることなどを要因に挙げた。富裕層による支出が全体をカバーしたり、衣類よりもジュエリー類に堅調さが見られたりする傾向があるという。このほか、中国や米国では自国産のブランドに対する関心の高まりも見られるという。

ＳＴＯＸＸ欧州高級品株１０種指数は今年に入って２０％超下落。人工知能（ＡＩ）関連株の下落が高級ブランドの消費にも悪影響を及ぼす可能性が指摘されている。

item.title: 米中古住宅仮契約指数、10月は調査開始以来最低 金利上昇重し
item.description: [ワシントン １８日 ロイター] - 全米リアルター協会（ＮＡＲ）が１８日発表した１０月の米中古住宅販売仮契約指数は...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
米中古住宅仮契約指数、10月は調査開始以来最低　金利上昇重し 0:40 配信

7月14日、米カリフォルニア州エンシニタスで売却済みの住宅を示す不動産の看板。REUTERS/Mike Blake（ロイター） [ワシントン １８日 ロイター] - 全米リアルター協会（ＮＡＲ）が１８日発表した１０月の米中古住宅販売仮契約指数は前月比で４．７％低下の６３．０と、２００１年の統計開始以来の低水準となった。住宅ローン金利の上昇が住宅需要を抑制していることが背景にある。

ロイターがまとめたエコノミスト予想は２．０％低下だった。大幅な低下は、先月に続き２カ月連続となった。

前年同月比では１６．７％低下した。契約件数は４地域全てで減少した。

米国とイスラエルによるイランとの戦争が続く中、住宅ローン金利は高止まりしている。住宅金融機関フレディマックのデータによると、３０年固定住宅ローンの先週の平均金利は７．１８％だった。１０月半ばには、約３年ぶりの高水準となる７．４０％まで上昇していた。

ＮＡＲのチーフエコノミスト、ローレンス・ユン氏は「販売仮契約指数が２カ月連続で過去最低となったことは、第４・四半期の住宅成約が極めて低調になることを示している。中古住宅の年間販売件数は１９９０年代半ば以来の低水準となる可能性がある」と述べた。

item.title: ウィットコフ米特使、19日にベルリン訪問 ウクライナ・欧州と協議＝当局者
item.description: [ワシントン １８日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
[ワシントン １８日 ロイター] - 米国のウィットコフ和平交渉担当特使とトランプ米大統領の娘婿ジャレッド・クシュナー氏が１９日にベルリンを訪問し、ウクライナ政府当局者のほか、欧州の交渉団と会談する。ロシアとウクライナの戦争終結に向けた取り組みを加速させることが目的という。米当局者が１８日、明らかにした。

当局者によると、一連の会談でウクライナに対する「信頼性のある戦後安全保障の保証」の具体化を進めるほか、包括的な経済復興計画や、次回の多国間協議に向けた準備などについて協議する。

item.title: ＵＢＳ、Ｓ＆Ｐ５００種の27年末目標を8200に設定 好調な業績支え
item.description: [１８日 ロイター] - ＵＢＳグローバル・ウェルス・マネジメントは１８日、米主要株価指数のＳ＆Ｐ総合５００種の２０２...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
ＵＢＳ、Ｓ＆Ｐ５００種の27年末目標を8200に設定　好調な業績支え 0:20 配信

8月18日、米ニューヨーク証券取引所（NYSE）で撮影。REUTERS/Jeenah Moon（ロイター） [１８日 ロイター] - ＵＢＳグローバル・ウェルス・マネジメントは１８日、米主要株価指数のＳ＆Ｐ総合５００種の２０２７年末の目標を８２００に設定した。堅調な経済成長と好調な企業収益に支えられるとの見方を示した。

ただ、高過ぎる業績期待や人工知能（ＡＩ）を巡る不透明感が依然として残っていることが、一段の上昇を抑える可能性があるとも指摘。市場の関心は、現在のＡＩ投資サイクルが２７年以降も利益成長を支えられるかどうかに移っていると分析した。

ＵＢＳは、米国株を「中立（ニュートラル）」に引き下げた上で、「ＡＩを巡るカニバリゼーション（共食い）、資金調達、実行リスクが高まっている一方、期待感や指数への集中度は依然として高い」と指摘。「上昇は見込まれるものの、その過程は変動が激しい可能性がある」と述べた。

このＳ＆Ｐ５００指数の２７年目標値は、現行水準から約１２％の上昇余地を示唆しており、ウェルズ・ファーゴの見方と概ね一致するものの、ゴールドマン・サックスやモルガン・スタンレーのより強気な予想を下回っている。

ＵＢＳは、Ｓ＆Ｐ５００の業績は２６年に２９％増加し、２７年にはさらに１５％拡大するとの見通しを示した。

また、世界のＡＩ関連投資は２７年には１兆４０００億ドルに増加し、２８年には１兆５０００億ドルに達すると予想。「業績の伸びは鈍化するものの、底堅い経済活動と継続的なＡＩ投資が２７年の利益を支えると見込む」との見方を示した。

ロイター 関連リンク アングル：米株、下半期の上昇基調維持に多くの試練　ＡＩ投資から金融政策まで アングル：ハイテク株への依存度を高める米株価指数、新たなリスクも 焦点：最高値圏に戻した米株、投機ポジションやオプション取引は一段高示唆 焦点：米株がイラン攻撃前の水準回復、短期終結への期待変わらず 焦点：米株の上昇銘柄に広がり　テック一辺倒から変化の兆し 11/19(木) 0:20 最終更新 ロイター

item.title: 米民主党、商務長官を調査 エヌビディア関連で親族企業に利益誘導か
item.description: [１８日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
[１８日 ロイター] - ラトニック米商務長官が自身の立場を利用し、息子らが支配する投資会社キャンター・フィッツジェラルドについて、半導体大手エヌビディアの不祥事を巡る損失回避を図ろうとしたかどうか、民主党議員らが調査に着手した。ロイターが入手した書簡で明らかになった。

１１月１７日付の書簡で、民主党のジェイミー・ラスキン、グレゴリー・ミークス、シドニー・カムラガードーブの各下院議員は、ラトニック長官の息子でキャンター・フィッツジェラルド会長を務めるブランドン・ラトニック氏に対し、商務長官が取ったいかなる行動も「キャンター・フィッツジェラルドの保有資産や事業上の利益によって不適切な影響を受けた」かどうかを確認するため、情報提供を求めると通知した。

議員らは、ラトニック長官が、シンガポール拠点のクラウドコンピューティング企業メガスピードをエンティティーリスト（禁輸リスト）に加えることや、メガスピードへの先端ＡＩ半導体輸出の許可義務付けを拒んだことに対し、キャンター・フィッツジェラルドの「財務上のエクスポージャー」などに関する懸念が影響したかどうかを尋ねた。

メガスピードは、エヌビディアのジェンスン・フアン前最高経営責任者（ＣＥＯ）が、中国のスパイとされるメガスピードの元幹部アリス・フアン氏と不倫関係にあったとの報道を受け、注目を集めている。

書簡を受け、商務省の報道官は声明で「長官は、資産売却や職務回避の全ての要件を含め、倫理協定の条件を完全に順守しており、今後も順守し続ける。キャンター・フィッツジェラルド、ニューマーク、ＢＧＣに保有していた金融資産を全て処分している」と表明した。この書簡は、英紙フィナンシャル・タイムズ（ＦＴ）が最初に報じた。

キャンター・フィッツジェラルドは書簡の主張を否定し、エヌビディア株の重要な自己保有ポジションは持っていないと説明した。エヌビディア株の保有は主に顧客向けに執行したエクイティスワップから生じたものだと述べた。また同社は、米国の輸出管理やエンティティーリストに関する決定には一切関与していないとした。

ベセント米財務長官は１３日、メガスピードについて、財務省を含む４政府機関がエンティティーリストへの追加を支持していたものの、商務省が同調していなかったと明らかにした。

item.title: 中国、エヌビディア製半導体確保目指す ＡＩ兵器向け＝報告書
item.description: [１８日 ロイター] - 中国軍が人工知能（ＡＩ）を活用した兵器向けに、米半導体大手エヌビディア 製の最先端半導体の調...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
中国、エヌビディア製半導体確保目指す　ＡＩ兵器向け＝報告書 0:02 配信

6月11日撮影。 REUTERS/Dado Ruvic/Illustration/File Photo（ロイター） [１８日 ロイター] - 中国軍が人工知能（ＡＩ）を活用した兵器向けに、米半導体大手エヌビディア 製の最先端半導体の調達を目指していることが、１８日に公表された米議会委員会の年次報告書で明らかになった。中国製ＡＩ半導体が依然、米国の競合他社に遅れをとっていることが背景にある。

米中経済安全保障調査委員会は報告書で、中国当局が「智能化」戦争の推進に不可欠な先端半導体を確保するため、米国の輸出規制を回避しようとしていると指摘した。

報告書によると、中国の華為技術（ファーウェイ）や中科寒武紀科技（カンブリコン）などの最先端ＡＩ半導体は依然としてエヌビディアや米ＡＭＤ製に及ばないという。

エヌビディアのジェンスン・フアン前最高経営責任者（ＣＥＯ）は先週、不倫騒動の中辞任した。フアン氏と不倫関係があったとされる中国人実業家の女性は中国のスパイだったと疑われている。

エヌビディアは米国の輸出規制により中国のＡＩデータセンター市場から事実上締め出されているとしている。しかし、ロイターの調査では、同社の規制対象となっている半導体を前提とした中国のコンピューティング事業の規模は総額３０億ドルを超えることが分かっている。

ロイター 関連リンク アングル：ＡＩ投資に迫られる「総点検」、見えないリスクの把握急務に アングル：「フアン氏の代わりはいない」、ＡＩ業界　最大級の擁護者失うリスク アングル：中国「独身の日」、世界最大級セールでＡＩトークンが新たな目玉に アングル：巧妙化するサイバー攻撃、攻撃する側もされる側も「ＡＩ武装」 焦点：オープンＡＩの甘いセキュリティー管理、従業員は以前から警鐘 11/19(木) 0:02 最終更新 ロイター

item.title: ＦＲＢ、積極的な物価対応必要 来月0.5％利上げも＝ウォラー理事
item.description:
Howard Schneider
[ワシントン １８日 ロイター] - 米連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）のウォラー理事は１８...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
ＦＲＢ、積極的な物価対応必要　来月0.5％利上げも＝ウォラー理事 11/18 23:45 配信

１１月１７日撮影　REUTERS/David 'Dee' Delgado（ロイター） Howard Schneider

[ワシントン １８日 ロイター] - 米連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）のウォラー理事は１８日、インフレによって国民の物価に対する心理が変化しつつあることを懸念しており、ＦＲＢはインフレに一段と積極的に対応する必要があるとの認識を示した。その上で、１２月の次回会合で０．５％ポイントの利上げを決定するか、来年に一段と速いペースで利上げを進める方針を市場に示すべきとの考えを示した。

ウォラー氏はＣＮＢＣのインタビューに対し「インフレは望ましくない方向に向かっており、その広がりも見られる」とし、足元で価格上昇が加速している品目の多くがサービス部門に属しており、高騰する原油価格やその他の一時的要因の影響を主に受けているわけではないと指摘。「インフレを本当に抑制したいなら、一段と積極的な措置を取り始めなければならない」とし、１２月８─９日の連邦公開市場委員会（ＦＯＭＣ）で通常より大幅な０．５％ポイントの利上げを決定するか、ＦＯＭＣ声明のほか、ウォーシュＦＲＢ議長のＦＯＭＣ後の記者会見を通じて、今後の追加利上げに対する市場の期待形成を図るべきとの考えを示した。

その上で、インフレ率はこのところ年率換算で３％を上回る水準で推移しており、加速している可能性もあると指摘。企業経営者がこうした水準を「通常」と受け止め、その分を消費者価格に転嫁するべきと考え始めていることを懸念していると述べた。「『３％程度の値上げなら受け入れられると考え、その分を価格に転嫁した』という声が聞かれ始めている。そうなるとインフレを引き下げるのが難しくなる。今後の基準として考えるべき数字は３％ではないと人々に認識してもらう必要がある。われわれは、こうした心理を打ち破らなければならない」とし、「今後２年かけて取り組むような話ではない」と述べ、迅速な対応の必要性を強調した。

ウォラー理事は１０日、米国の１０月のインフレ率が鈍化したとしてもＦＲＢは１２月の会合で利上げを支持する考えを示し、物価情勢が悪化した場合は０．５％ポイントの大幅利上げを検討する必要があると発言。ウォラー氏の発言後に米労働省が発表した１０月の消費者物価指数（ＣＰＩ）は前月比０．４％上昇し、市場予想（０．３％）を上回った。

ウォラー氏はこの日のインタビューで、現時点での選択肢は、０．５％ポイントの利上げを実施して市場が織り込む０．２５％ポイント利上げの見通しを覆すか、来年１月にも追加利上げを行い、その後も利上げを継続する方針を極めて明確に示すかのいずれかだと指摘。こうした方針はＦＯＭＣ声明で示すこともできるほか、「ＦＲＢ議長が記者会見で言及することもできる」と指摘。「何らかの対応が必要だ」とし、「そうでなければ１２月に０．５％ポイントの利上げを実施しなければならない。それを決めて実行すべきだ」と語った。

ウォーシュＦＲＢ議長はできる限り「フォワードガイダンス（将来の政策方針に関する事前説明）」を避けたいとの考えを示しているが、ウォラー理事は現在のような局面ではＦＲＢが強力なコミュニケーションを活用し、インフレ心理の高まりを抑制する必要があると指摘。「議長には自身のコミュニケーション手法があり、それは構わない。それが議長の考え方だ」とした上で、「私は長年この仕事に携わってきた。コミュニケーションは政策手段の一つとして活用すべきだ。市場がわれわれの仕事を後押しするよう、コミュニケーションを活用するべきだ」と語った。

ＦＲＢは９月のＦＯＭＣで０．２５％ポイントの利上げを決定。利上げは２０２３年７月以来、３年２カ月ぶりだった。１０月のＦＯＭＣではフェデラルファンド（ＦＦ）金利誘導目標を３．７５－４．００％に据え置くと決定したが、１２月８─９日の次回ＦＯＭＣでは少なくとも０．２５％ポイントの利上げを決定するとの見方が大勢になっている。

ロイター 関連リンク アングル：金価格、米国債利回り上昇でも4000ドル台維持　中銀の準備資産分散が下支え コラム：トランプ米大統領、任期中の利下げは望み薄　市場は高金利長期化を想定 コラム：米10年債利回り、利上げ局面でどこまで上昇　6％到達も視野 アングル：ＦＯＭＣで利上げほぼ確実、ウォーシュ氏の政策説明も不可避か コラム：ＦＯＭＣと日銀会合、金融政策ウイークの注目点＝植野大作氏 11/18(水) 23:45 最終更新 ロイター

item.title: EXCLUSIVE-サウジ、対フーシ派戦争長期化へ備え 来年まで継続視野=関係筋
item.description:
Timour Azhari Humeyra Pamuk
[リヤド １８日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
Timour Azhari　Humeyra Pamuk

[リヤド １８日 ロイター] - サウジアラビアが、イエメンの親イラン武装組織フーシ派との戦闘について、来年に入っても長期化する事態に備えていることが分かった。イエメンでの戦況悪化やサウジ国内への攻撃による混乱にもかかわらず、戦闘を継続する構えだ。サウジ側から計画について説明を受けた西側当局者２人が明らかにした。

戦争を巡る国内向けの情報発信も、その影響をより認める方向へと徐々に変化している。

西側当局者によると、サウジ当局者は現在、この軍事作戦が最長で６カ月続くと見込んでいる。フーシ派との交渉に入る前に、サウジが支援するイエメン側勢力が地上で戦果を上げることを目指している。

サウジの計画に詳しい３人目の関係者も、こうした説明を裏付けた。３人全員が、より広範なイランとの戦争を終わらせる合意が成立すれば、イエメン紛争も収束に向かう可能性があると述べた。

この３人目の関係者はまた、サウジ側は、イエメンでの作戦に対する米国の支援があれば、紛争の潮目を変える助けとなり得ると考えていると語った。トランプ政権はサウジへの攻撃支援をこれまで差し控えてきたが、それが実現すれば、サウジが支援する部隊が望む戦果を数週間以内に上げられる可能性があるという。

サウジ外務省の当局者は、西側当局者が説明したサウジ当局者の見解についてコメントを控えた。

サウジはフーシ派との紛争再開を、イエメン国内の問題と位置付けようとしてきた。サウジはイエメン側の同盟勢力を支援し、越境攻撃から自国を防衛しているものの、戦争の完全な当事者ではないという立場だ。

しかし、サウジ国内への攻撃が繰り返される中で、この立場を維持することは次第に難しくなっている。

フーシ派の攻撃は先週、リヤドにある国有石油会社サウジアラムコの本部に大きな被害を与えた。リヤドの空港に対しても一連の攻撃が行われ、死傷者が出ているほか、１０月以降、空港は大部分の便に対して閉鎖された状態が続いている

item.title: 欧州の生活水準、ロシア産エネ遮断で「屈辱的な」低下＝プーチン氏
item.description:
Gleb Bryanski
[モスクワ １８日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
Gleb Bryanski

[モスクワ １８日 ロイター] - ロシアのプーチン大統領は１８日、欧州連合（ＥＵ）がロシア産の石油・天然ガスを遮断する決定を下したことが、欧州の生活水準の「屈辱的な」低下を招いたとの見方を示した。こうした中、ドイツのロビー団体が実施した調査では、会員企業の多くが供給再開を望んでいることが明らかになった。

ＥＵは、ロシアが２０２２年にウクライナ侵攻を開始して以降、ロシア産エネルギーの段階的な廃止を進めており、液化天然ガス（ＬＮＧ）の輸入を２６年末までに、パイプライン経由のガス輸入を２７年９月３０日までに全て停止する計画を明らかにしている。

プーチン氏は中国・深センで開催中のアジア太平洋経済協力会議（ＡＰＥＣ）首脳会議で各国の最高経営責任者（ＣＥＯ）を前に講演し、安価で安定したロシア産エネルギー資源の供給が、数十年にもわたり欧州の繁栄を支えてきたとの考えを表明。その上で、ＥＵは今や産業面での潜在力と競争力を失いつつあるとし、財政赤字や巨額の債務、インフレを指摘した。

プーチン氏は「これら全てが欧州の企業と市民に重くのしかかっており、生活水準は屈辱的な形で着実に低下している」と述べた。

欧州委員会は、ロシア側の主張に対するコメント要請に直ちには応じなかった。

一方、ロビー団体のドイツ・ロシア商工会議所が実施した調査によると、ロシアと取引のある会員企業７５０社のうち、６５％ができるだけ早期のエネルギー供給再開を支持していることが明らかになった。ロイターが入手した同調査によると、さらに３１％が戦争終結後の供給再開を支持していることも示された。

同会議所の試算によると、２７年のガス先物価格と２５年の消費水準に基づくと、ノルドストリーム・パイプラインを通じた供給再開により、ドイツは年間９５億ユーロ（１０４億４０００万ドル）を節約できるという。

同会議所のエネルギー専門家、トーマス・バイヤー氏は「パイプラインガスの追加供給は、特にドイツのエネルギー集約型産業にとって大幅な負担軽減につながるだろう」と述べた。

メルツ独首相の政権は、ロシア産ガス供給の再開に反対している。

TURIN, Italy, Nov 18 : World number three Carlos Alcaraz eased past Daniil Medvedev 6-2 6-4 on Wednesday to move to the brink of a semi-final spot at the season-ending ATP Finals. Alcaraz, seeking his maiden ATP Finals title, needed just 72 minutes to stretch his winning run to 11 matches after clinching back-to-back titles in Vienna and Paris. He has won three titles since coming back to the tour at the US Open following a four-month break due to a wrist injury.  He must wait for the other group match between Flavio Cobolli and Frances Tiafoe to find out whether he has secured a last-four spot with a match to spare.  "I think I did everything well," said Alcaraz, who also beat Medvedev in Vienna. "We could see in his first match that he was serving really well. He got a lot of free points with his serve and I just returned really well.

"On second serves I returned really aggressively and really deep, and I would say after that I was playing great, in my game style." The 23-year-old found little resistance as he clinched the first set thanks to two consecutive breaks. Alcaraz picked up where he left off with another early break in the second and Russian Medvedev, ATP Finals champion six years ago, was unable to match the Spaniard's power. Alcaraz, who this year became the youngest man to complete the career Grand Slam when he claimed his seventh major title at the Australian Open, took a medical timeout and had his left thigh bandaged.  It had no impact on his game, however, as he served out the match and clinched victory when Medvedev sent a return into the net.

FAST

Nov 18 : "Grand Theft Auto VI" is winning praise from players and critics as it rolls out worldwide, and Wall Street is joining the chorus. Shares of Take-Two Interactive, publisher of the latest edition in the iconic GTA franchise, surged more than 8 per cent on Wednesday as investors bet that glowing initial reviews will fuel demand further and boost the company's bookings and revenue this year. Players waited more than 13 years for GTA VI, and are now doing everything from taking several days of paid time off to signing "contracts" with their partners to get uninterrupted game time. The demand has been feverish. Even with a high bar for player satisfaction, GTA VI saw a flood of early positive reviews and clinched a score of 99 on aggregator site Metacritic.

"There may have been anxiety around GTA VI's ability to live up to the hype from a quality perspective. With the Metacritic score at 99, any questions around quality have been put to bed," said Nick McKay, video gaming and digital entertainment senior analyst at Freedom Capital Markets. "The wait appears to have been worth it for gamers and investors alike." Take-Two's stock, down 19 per cent this year through last close, was the top gainer in the Nasdaq-100 index on Wednesday. Wells Fargo analysts raised their estimates for GTA VI sales, projecting about 65 million units in its current fiscal year that runs through March, up from prior projections of 35 million units. The forecast is also underpinned by expectations for a potential PC release early in 2027. The brokerage raised its annual bookings forecast for Take-Two by 19 per cent to $9.76 billion, versus a consensus estimate of $8 billion from LSEG data, and Take-Two's own projection of $8 billion to $8.20 billion. GTA TIDE LIFTS MANY BOATS Another brokerage, Oppenheimer, estimates about $1.85 billion in gross revenue in the first three days, compared with the $1 billion recorded by its predecessor, GTA V, when it was released in 2013. The buzz is expected to lift the broader video game market, with industry researcher Newzoo forecasting 3 per cent growth in the global console player base in 2026, versus a likely decline in the market without GTA VI. "Few releases can change how the whole console market spends, and GTA VI is one of those rare titles," Newzoo's Director of Market Intelligence Emmanuel Rosier said. Analytics firm Sensor Tower estimates the launch will also generate more than 50 million additional visits to food delivery and restaurant apps within 30 days in the US, as gamers hunker down for extended play sessions. Social media apps including YouTube and Reddit are also expected to see greater engagement as fans discuss the game's features and share gameplay clips. Shares of DoorDash rose 2 per cent, while those of Reddit were marginally higher. As of Wednesday noon ET, roughly 17.1 million GTA VI units had been sold, a Sensor Tower tracker showed, far exceeding pre-order volumes of all the biggest game releases in recent history.

Source: Reuters

item.title: 米10月一戸建て着工、前月比4.0％増 建設許可件数は急減
item.description:
Lucia Mutikani
[ワシントン １８日 ロイター] - 米商務省国勢調査局が１８日発表した１０月の住宅着工...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
米10月一戸建て着工、前月比4.0％増　建設許可件数は急減 11/18 23:10 配信

米カリフォルニア州エンシニタスの新築の一戸建て住宅。8月20日撮影。REUTERS/Mike Blake（ロイター） Lucia Mutikani

[ワシントン １８日 ロイター] - 米商務省国勢調査局が１８日発表した１０月の住宅着工件数（季節調整済み）は、住宅建設の大部分を占める一戸建てが年率換算で前月比４．０％増の８６万４０００戸となった。前月から回復したものの、住宅ローン金利の上昇やインフレを背景に建設許可件数が急減しており、今回の改善は一時的なものにとどまる公算が大きい。

一戸建て住宅の建設許可件数は８．７％減の７７万２０００戸に落ち込んだ。米国とイスラエルによるイランとの戦争が住宅ローン金利を押し上げ、多くの若年層が住宅市場から締め出されている。

キャピタル・エコノミクスの北米担当エコノミスト、ブラッドリー・ソーンダース氏は「住宅建設は依然として低迷している。高水準の借り入れコストが需要を圧迫すると同時に建設費を大幅に押し上げ、開発業者に打撃を与えている」と述べた。

住宅金融機関フレディマックのデータによると、３０年固定住宅ローン金利は、２月下旬の紛争開始以降１２０ベーシスポイント（ｂｐ）急上昇し、先週は平均７．１８％となった。

変動の大きい５戸以上の集合住宅の着工件数は前月比２５．５％増の年率換算４３万３０００戸と急増した。前年同月比では２２．０％増加した。

住宅着工件数全体は前月比９．９％増の年率換算１３０万９０００戸に回復した。ロイターがまとめたエコノミスト予想は１２４万５０００戸だった。前年同月比では２．８％増加した。

集合住宅の建設許可件数は前月比５．２％減の年率換算４７万５０００戸だった。建設許可件数全体は７．４％減の１２９万５０００戸。エコノミストは１３７万７０００戸への増加を予想していた。前年同月比では８．７％減少した。

高水準の住宅ローン金利が住宅需要を抑制していることに加え、トランプ政権による移民取り締まりも住宅建設を制約している。開発業者はエネルギーや資材の価格高騰によるコスト圧力の増大にも直面している

住宅建設を含む住宅投資は、直近１０四半期のうち８四半期で縮小している。ただ、住宅市場が国内総生産（ＧＤＰ）に占める割合は小さく、住宅市場の低迷が経済全体に与える打撃は軽微なものにとどまっている。

ロイター 関連リンク アングル：協調介入の米関与は限定的の受け止め、円再び160円台に　安値試しも 焦点：米財政運営巡る政治対立リスク、民主党勝利で市場が注目 アングル：米移民摘発、過去最高の逮捕件数も送還難航　法的手続きや移送能力に壁 焦点：テスラ、ロボタクシー「サイバーキャブ」で試す規制の限界 コラム：日銀利上げの「美しいシナリオ」に弱点はないか＝上野泰也氏 11/19(木) 1:22 最終更新 ロイター

Nov 18 : Scotland captain Sione Tuipulotu is among seven players who have left the squad ahead of Saturday’s Nations Championship test against Japan, while flanker Jack Dempsey faces surgery on a foot injury. • Scott Cummings, Ben White, Alex Craig and Fergus Burke are all injured and prop Ollie Blyth-Lafferty has been released back to his club. • Tuipulotu was a late withdrawal from the 15-12 victory over Australia on Sunday after aggravating a knee problem. • Cummings landed awkwardly from a lineout against Australia and limped off, while scrumhalf White started the test at Murrayfield with his left leg heavily strapped and went off early in the second half.

FAST

JAKARTA: Indonesia and China agreed on Wednesday (Nov 18) four strategic partnerships worth US$71.8 billion, including the development of 10 smart cities, according to a statement from Indonesia's presidential palace. The agreement involves the development of 10 smart cities through a partnership between Indonesia's sovereign wealth fund Danantara and a consortium led by China's Shaanxi Construction Engineering Group Corporation Limited with an investment value of around US$50 billion. "It will become one of the most historic projects to be developed early next year," said Danantara CEO Rosan Roeslani. Earlier this month, Danantara said it would develop a dozen smart cities across Indonesia, envisioned as modern, integrated urban areas combining residential communities, universities, hospitals, shopping centres, and well-planned urban infrastructure. The partnerships were agreed in China and witnessed by Indonesian President Prabowo Subianto as he was in the country to attend the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation summit in Shenzhen. Other partnerships that Danantara signed included the establishment of laboratories and manufacturing of household appliances with Chinese appliance maker Hisense worth US$10 billion and another US$10 billion on infrastructure financing cooperation with a consortium led by China's State Development and Investment Corporation (SDIC). The last partnership was on coal-to-ethanol technology between Indonesia's higher education ministry, Indonesian state energy firm Pertamina and Beijing Petrochemical Engineering Co Ltd, with an investment value of US$1.8 billion.

Source: Reuters/ao

Commemoration in Italian parliament of ex-fascist leader causes uproar

18 November, 2026 07:00 pm IST

By Angelo Amante ROME, Nov 18 (Reuters) – Italy’s parliament ordered the removal of fascist imagery from an exhibition honouring Pino Rauti, a prominent far-right politician and admirer of Benito Mussolini, after an exhibition in the lower house sparked an opposition outcry.

Rauti, who died in 2012, volunteered for the Italian Social Republic, the Nazi-backed puppet state led by Mussolini in northern Italy during World War Two, and remained closely identified with the dictator’s legacy during his long career.

Among the images displayed was a photograph of Rauti speaking beneath a flag bearing a Celtic cross, a symbol widely associated with neo-fascist movements, while the exhibition also featured portraits of Mussolini.

Show Full Article

Following protests from the centre-left Democratic Party (PD), the lower house administration ordered organisers to remove the images and by Wednesday morning, they were no longer on show.

EXTREMIST VIOLENCE SCARRED ITALY

Rauti was a leading figure in the neo-fascist Italian Social Movement (MSI), which was founded by supporters of Mussolini and is regarded as the political predecessor of Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni’s Brothers of Italy party.

In the 1950s, Rauti founded the Centro Studi Ordine Nuovo, which emerged from a group that played a prominent role in extremist violence during Italy’s “Years of Lead”. Rauti was investigated over some of the period’s attacks, but was ultimately cleared of all charges.

The exhibition to mark the 100th anniversary of his birth, entitled “The Man, the Politician and the Intellectual”, was sponsored by the culture ministry and includes videos, audio and material from Rauti’s family archive.

“I went to see the exhibition on Pino Rauti. I came away incredulous. Because, as I feared, it is not an exhibition but a celebration,” said Alfredo Bazoli, a PD senator.

Bazoli’s mother was killed in a 1974 bombing in the northern city of Brescia that was linked to Ordine Nuovo. He described the exhibition as “a blatant attempt to rewrite history”.

“What is particularly troubling is that it is being sponsored by members of Brothers of Italy, which evidently has yet to sever its ties with this dark chapter of our country’s history,” he said.

Federico Mollicone, a Brothers of Italy lawmaker who chairs the lower house culture committee, defended the exhibition, saying it was intended solely to recount Rauti’s political trajectory.

“It is the history of a political tradition in Italy that not only existed, but unquestionably left a fundamental legacy,” he said.

Meloni has not commented on the controversy.

The prime minister praised Mussolini in her youth, but has since sought to distance herself from fascism, saying in 2022 that she “never felt any sympathy” for it. She has also said there should be no place in Brothers of Italy for nostalgia for fascism, racism or antisemitism.

(Reporting by Angelo Amante; Editing by Crispian Balmer)

Pochettino posted a photo of Manches

MANCHESTER, England, Nov 18 : Mauricio Pochettino arrived at Manchester United on Wednesday morning, after an overnight flight took their new manager from his final match in charge of the US team into a relegation battle at a club desperately seeking a revival in fortunes. Pochettino posted a photo of Manchester from the air on Instagram, signalling the end of his seven-hour journey from Cincinnati. A private plane had whisked him away shortly after the US beat Haiti on Tuesday, and the 54-year-old Argentine was driven straight to United's training centre at Carrington. Pochettino has precious little time to settle into his new surroundings, however, with an away Premier League game at arch-rivals Liverpool looming large on Sunday.

United announced Pochettino's appointment on Friday, following Michael Carrick's sacking, with the manager delaying his arrival to lead the US in their two-legged CONCACAF Nations League quarter-final. His focus must swiftly switch from international football to the daily grind of club management, where a harsh spotlight will follow his every move and a drastic change in form is needed, and quickly. United have not won the league title since 2013, when long-serving manager Alex Ferguson retired, and the 20-times English champions have registered one win in 10 league games this season to lie 18th in the table, their lowest position at this stage of a top-flight campaign since 1986-87. That was the season Ferguson took charge, and 40 years later Pochettino arrives in similar circumstances. FERGIE TIME Ferguson was given time at United, whose wait for another league title had reached almost two decades upon his arrival. Two days after taking charge, Ferguson's side lost at Oxford United and dropped into the relegation zone. Manchester United finished 11th that season, and had to wait until 1993 for Ferguson to deliver the title, although he did win a European Cup Winners' Cup, FA Cup and League Cup along the way. Pochettino, whose only league title as a manager came at Paris St Germain, is unlikely to be afforded such patience. US midfielder DaMarcus Beasley, who spent a season on-loan at Manchester City, joked with Pochettino in a post-game interview on TNT Sports on Tuesday that "Manchester will always be blue". "No way, you will see," Pochettino replied. "Give me time, give me time and that is going to start to change, for sure."

Source: Reuters

FAST

NEW YORK/LONDON, Nov 18 : A gauge of global stocks fell in choppy trading on Wednesday after Nvidia's quarterly results and ahead of Anthropic's market debut, while the dollar's strength also weighed on sentiment. The dollar strengthened to a fresh 19-month high after US Federal Reserve Governor Christopher Waller told CNBC the central bank needs to either approve a half-point interest rate hike at its December meeting or communicate a faster pace of hikes in 2027. Mining stocks dragged European shares lower, while Nvidia's results initially helped Asian shares, with Korea's Kospi up 2 per cent overnight. But the Nvidia rally fizzled and the stock was down 2.4 per cent after rising as much as 2.7 per cent. Nvidia's board dismissed the idea of rehiring former CEO Jensen Huang, who resigned last week. The company forecast sales ahead of Wall Street targets on Tuesday.

"The central question Nvidia faces is not related to this earnings report ... it's more about what the company may look like in 3-5 years without a visionary leader like Jensen and as competition from other chipmakers takes shape," said Jay Peters, portfolio manager at NewEdge Wealth. The Dow Jones Industrial Average fell 0.84 per cent to 50,334.82, the S&P 500 eased 0.07 per cent to 7,335.43 and the Nasdaq Composite rose 0.46 per cent to 24,439.22.  MSCI's gauge of global stocks fell 0.34 per cent to 1,075.82 and the pan-European STOXX 600 index dropped 1.03 per cent. Emerging market stocks eased 0.13 per cent and Japan's Nikkei rose 0.28 per cent. The next health check on the AI industry will come as Anthropic prepares to price its shares on Wednesday ahead of its market debut. DOLLAR UP, OIL DOWN In currencies, the dollar strengthened as Waller's comments and recent economic data cemented expectations for an interest rate hike next month. "The Federal Reserve seems at the moment to be very determined to hike interest rates and maybe even aggressively do so," said Juan Perez, senior director of trading at Monex USA in Washington. "That's the belief right now that's carrying the US dollar." The dollar index rose 0.19 per cent to 103.81, with the euro down 0.24 per cent at $1.0971. In commodities markets, crude prices fell after US crude and fuel inventories rose more than expected, adding to expectations of a supply surplus.  US crude fell 4.39 per cent to $82.23 a barrel and Brent dropped to $90.93 per barrel, down 2.37 per cent. Spot gold fell 2.86 per cent to $3,739.66 an ounce and spot silver lost 4.72 per cent to $45.16 an ounce. Copper declined 4.69 per cent to $12,606.00 a ton. US Treasury yields were slightly lower as oil prices dropped, dragging inflation expectations lower. The yield on benchmark US 10-year notes fell 3.87 basis points to 5.064 per cent from 5.103 per cent late on Tuesday, while the 30-year bond yield fell 4.49 basis points to 5.414 per cent from 5.459 per cent.

Source: Reuters

Malaysia says data centres must comply with US AI chip rules

Malaysia has emerged as a regional data centre hub, attracting nearly US$100 billion in investments since 2021, but analysts warn tighter scrutiny of AI chip deployment could slow growth in the sector.

A worker walks past a data centre in Johor state, which has become Southeast Asia's fastest-growing data centre hub, at Gelang Patah, Malaysia, on May 7, 2026. (File Photo: REUTERS/Hasnoor Hussain)

FAST

KUALA LUMPUR: Malaysia's data centre operators should comply with new United States restrictions on advanced artificial intelligence chips, Trade Minister Johari Abdul Ghani said on Wednesday (Nov 18) after Washington announced fresh curbs on shipments of high-performance semiconductors. Malaysia has emerged as a regional data centre hub, attracting nearly US$100 billion in investments since 2021, but analysts warn tighter scrutiny of AI chip deployment could slow growth in the sector. Johari told Reuters he was unclear how the new rules would impact financing requirements of individual firms, but data centre players should comply with the US rules on chips, which were considered strategic assets. "Malaysia remains open to investment, and the new US rules and regulation will give investors and partners clear direction when operating in Malaysia," he said.

In separate remarks to Malaysian media, Johari said Malaysia would seek clarification from US authorities on the restrictions, particularly on licensing and the provision of data centre services to third parties. Malaysia will inform all 117 approved data centre projects in the country to ensure compliance once the requirements are communicated, he said, according to a report from state news agency Bernama. Firms whose transactions involve customers from non-US countries could require more extensive due diligence and know-your-customer checks by US authorities, he was quoted as saying Malaysia has yet to receive evidence that data centre tenants in Malaysia had traded or re-exported chips in violation of US rules, he said, according to Bernama. “If they re-export, we want to know who, and they have to come up with the manifests they submitted. Only then can we proceed. We cannot simply accuse,” he said. Malaysia is investigating the local unit of Singapore-based cloud computing firm Megaspeed, which is facing a US probe into whether it was used to circumvent export controls on AI chips. Megaspeed, a customer of AI chipmaker Nvidia, has denied the allegations, saying it takes its US compliance obligations extremely seriously.

Source: Reuters/ao

FAST

CAPE TOWN, Nov 18 : South Africa’s sports minister has ordered an inquiry into the treatment of Olympic swimming gold medallist Tatjana Smith, who has announced she will be representing the Netherlands in future. Smith, who raced previously under the surname Schoenmaker before getting married, is South Africa’s most decorated Olympian with four medals, holds dual citizenship and has changed allegiance after persistent complaints about Swimming South Africa officials. Minister Gayton McKenzie has apologised to her for the treatment, which included withholding her prize money from the 2023 World Aquatics Championships. She claimed $35,000 in prize money from Fukuoka, Japan was held back from her for 12 months and, when eventually paid, did not include interest, which she received only after engaging lawyers.

"She’s been treated in the worst possible way. They should be ashamed," McKenzie said. "Tatjana has been treated like an enemy of this country." McKenzie has asked the South African Sports Confederation and Olympic Committee (SASCOC) to investigate.  "If I could, I would come out there, and I will fire all of them immediately. That’s how I feel," he said. "But I can’t. Even if I want to, we shall be suspended by World Aquatics. The law says SASCOC must deal with this first. "If this is how they treat the greatest Olympian in our history, how are we treating our emerging stars? What is all this telling every young swimmer about what they can expect if nothing changes?" the minister said. 50 METRES TARGET IN 2028 Smith retired in 2024 but reversed her decision this year with her sights on the 2028 Olympics. The 200 metres breaststroke gold medallist in Tokyo and 100m breaststroke champion at the Paris Games, she is going for the 50m title in Los Angeles. "To South Africa, when I was a little girl, my biggest dream was to represent my country at the Olympics," Smith said in a tearful video statement on social media this month announcing her nationality switch. "I got to live that dream and it gave me more than I could have ever imagined. "This gives me the opportunity to explore another part of my identity and the heritage that I've never experienced through sport," said Smith, who has also won two Olympic silver medals. "The opportunity also offers greater high-performance support and the potential to build a more sustainable career."

Source: Reuters

As Meta bets big on Muse AI agent, early safety mishaps surface

Reuters

18 November, 2026 05:30 pm IST

Follow Us:

-->

Facebook

X

LinkedIn

WhatsApp

Email

Copy Link

(c) Copyright Thomson Reuters 2026

Stay updated with ThePrint:

Preferred Source

Google Discover

-->

By Katie Paul NEW YORK, Nov 18 (Reuters) – Meta’s AI agent Muse, embodied by a smiley, fuzzy mascot named Jolly, has burrowed into encrypted personal messages, supplied made-up information about purchases and sent users chats seemingly meant for other people, a fraught start for a bot meant to simplify life for consumers, according to internal company posts reviewed by Reuters.

The unbidden actions by Muse – one of the fastest-growing apps on record, with more than 10 million downloads since its September launch, and the centerpiece of Meta’s plan to generate billions of dollars in AI revenue – have prompted unnerved employees to raise concerns it could be mixing up conversations between different accounts and exposing users’ private data, the posts showed.

In some of those cases, Meta staffers reported the agent sending them messages about a childcare request they had not made, career advice they had not sought, product orders they had not placed and bank account balances that were not theirs.

Show Full Article

In one post, from earlier this month, an employee told colleagues his Muse had randomly added an extra message to its regular chats about fishing-related weather and tide information, saying: “BTW, two bank updates, your Capital One balance is $2722.58, your Charles Schwab balance is $5899.57.”

“I have never shared my bank account with Muse and never discussed any banking topic with Muse. I’m afraid it’s sending other’s bank info to me,” the staffer wrote in his post.

In another example, an employee using Muse on her personal phone reported it had surprised her with a reminder to respond to a message from her sister on Signal, an end-to-end encrypted messaging service popular with privacy advocates that competes with Meta’s WhatsApp.

“This seems like an extreme privacy violation. I definitely did not grant it access to other apps, or recall being asked about this,” the employee said in her post.

A colleague responded, saying he had discovered Muse was set up by default with permission to access push notifications on phones with Google’s Android operating system after being similarly caught off guard by unsolicited chats related to apps he had not connected.

For this story, Reuters reviewed more than two dozen internal posts describing undesired actions by Muse since its debut, many of them from a feedback group where Meta employees flag problems to the team building the agent. Reuters also worked with staff at Signal and the AI Now Institute, a non-profit that studies AI’s impact on society, to replicate Muse’s access to Signal messages. The results of those tests indicated the issue described by the Meta employees was ongoing and could be affecting others.

In response to questions about Signal access and other Muse safety concerns, Meta spokesperson Daniel Roberts described the Reuters examples as “isolated incidents,” saying the company prioritizes safety, conducts extensive internal testing and continuously updates products to improve protections.

Muse needs to see and interact with people’s computers in order to work on their behalf, and can access other apps only via permissions they explicitly grant, Roberts said. He said many of the messages flagged by employees as potential account mix-ups were hallucinations, a term referring to AI models’ tendency to make things up, and had already been addressed.

Reuters was unable to establish whether Muse was giving users other people’s bank account balances and other sensitive data, or making up the information.

DEEP ACCESS

The Muse incidents highlight the risks associated with an emerging category of consumer AI agents hitting the market from Meta, OpenAI and others, pitched as the next big wave of AI technology. The bots promise to reshape how digital exchanges operate by executing time-saving tasks like answering emails, booking appointments and making online purchases without direct instructions.

Meta is ahead of competitors so far, with Muse consistently topping app download charts after heavy promotion to the company’s more than 3.6 billion users on Facebook, Instagram and WhatsApp. The app’s retention rate is also strong, with around a quarter of the people who have set up Muse accounts returning to use it each day, the company has disclosed.

To work effectively, agents need deep access to smartphones and computers. However, they are also prone to making mistakes, exploiting obscure loopholes and accomplishing their objectives in sometimes harmful ways. OpenAI and Anthropic, for instance, have revealed instances of their AI agents unexpectedly hacking other companies and weakening systems designed to monitor their activities.

Some banks and retailers have responded to those risks by blocking agents. The technology is also posing new challenges for operating system providers like Apple and Google, which manage the permissions agents use to navigate around people’s devices. Apple, for instance, changed its operating system this week to give people more control over agents’ data usage after an Inc. Magazine columnist accused Muse of reading private chats from the Messages app on his Mac.

Meta has assured Muse users it isolates each agent in its own secure “virtual machine” – a cloud-based emulation of a personal computer – and gives people full control over which apps they connect. Meta CEO Mark Zuckerberg has cited those protections in dismissing calls for industry-wide AI safety standards, arguing companies already have incentives to build safe products, both to earn consumers’ trust and avoid legal risks. Even so, Meta warns incoming users Muse may make mistakes and its terms of service hold users responsible for the agent’s actions.

REPURPOSING SETTINGS

To find out how Muse might access encrypted messages without users’ knowledge, Reuters provided a description of the Meta employee’s post – where the bot randomly prompted her to respond to a Signal message – to staff at Signal and the AI Now Institute. Reuters then worked with them to replicate the access she had observed.

Testers prompted Muse to read Signal messages on different operating systems. On an Android phone and an Apple laptop, it responded by bypassing Meta’s “Connector” tool and instead using permissions granted during the bot’s initial setup to pull in the message text, leveraging those authorizations in ways a user might not anticipate.

Specifically, on Android, it used its permission to access the device’s push notifications to retrieve the messages, just as the Meta employees had described. On Apple’s macOS, it used a combination of the computer’s accessibility and screenshot tools, repurposing settings Apple offers to help people with disabilities operate their computers.

The same requests were blocked in tests conducted on an iPhone.

The results indicate Meta is interpreting the permissions granted by Muse users broadly, an approach that has long earned the company criticism from privacy advocates and hefty fines from regulators.

In response to Reuters’ findings, Signal President Meredith Whittaker accused Meta of launching Muse “without showing any respect for basic privacy or cybersecurity,” calling the deployment of agents that can gain wide access to people’s devices “technologically reckless.”

She called for app developers like Signal to be given “consistent technical ways” to mark their applications as off-limits to AI agents, for Meta and other AI companies to honor those boundaries and for operating system providers to enforce the rules.

Presented with the same findings, Apple and Google said they were considering changes to give people more control over what they authorize with AI agents – though Google, like Meta, noted that people already “must deliberately grant permissions” for apps to access Android notifications.

Apple said it had built its accessibility tools for people with disabilities and cautioned that leveraging them “for unintended purposes” could put people’s personal information at risk. Its operating system update this week effectively closed the pathway identified by Reuters, sharply restricting developers’ use of accessibility tools on Macs and introducing a new agent-oriented set of permissions.

“We are committed to ensuring users understand exactly what they are allowing, so they can make informed choices about their data and privacy,” Apple said in a statement.

‘NOT MY CONVERSATION’

In other cases discussed internally, staffers reported cases of Muse informing users about transactions that never occurred and making up prices on products they did purchase, costing them real money. In one incident, the agent booked a non-refundable Airbnb stay without permission, an employee reported.

Some of the incidents that raised the most concern involved cryptic out-of-context messages sent by the agent that appeared to contain other people’s information, in many cases phrased as replies to queries the users had never submitted.

In a late September social media post, a member of Meta’s Superintelligence team behind Muse initially described a user report of a similar problem as a temporary hallucination-related glitch, resolved the same day it arose. However, the internal posts reviewed by Reuters showed such incidents occurring as far back as mid-September and continuing through this month.

In one such post, an employee reported his Muse sending him a message “out of nowhere” saying it was unable to submit a request related to a parent’s control over who could access their child’s data.

He had done nothing to trigger the chat, and had never discussed child data or caregiving access with his Muse, he said.

When he asked Muse about the message, the bot replied: “I don’t have a good explanation for it other than that it wasn’t related to our conversation. Let’s ignore it. How can I help?”

Another staffer said Muse randomly offered to “message the seller” about picking up a coffee table. When the employee asked Muse, “What are you talking about?” the agent responded that it had “pulled in some context about a coffee table pickup that doesn’t seem to be yours.”

This was “not my conversation,” the employee said in his post, expressing concern about a “possible cross-account context leak.”

To address employee worries, another Superintelligence team member told the internal feedback group in early November that the agent appeared to be hallucinating messages in response to built-in prompts pushing it to engage with users in between sessions.

“These (hallucinations) unfortunately bias towards the most uncomfortable topics, like finances/security/safety, which sucks,” he said, adding that he was aware of several other cases involving “crypto-related things too, like giving people updates on their Bitcoin balances.”

He said the issues involved both the underlying AI model and the software enabling Muse to take actions, and that the team was working through them.

Roberts declined to answer Reuters questions about those issues, including how many there were and why they were persisting.

(Additional reporting by Stephen Nellis and Kenrick Cai in San Francisco; Editing by Anna Driver and Ken Li)

FAST

Nov 18 : Ireland flyhalf Sam Prendergast has been cleared to play in the Nations Championship against South Africa on Saturday after a citing for dangerous play was dismissed. The 23-year-old became the first player to be cited under World Rugby's new regulations for what was alleged to be a hip-drop tackle on Peceli Yato during the first half of last Saturday's 43-15 victory in Dublin. However, a Nations Championship disciplinary committee cleared him on Wednesday. "Having heard detailed evidence from Sam Prendergast and submissions made by (Irish rugby legal representative) Derek Hegarty and (Ireland coach) Andy Farrell, the committee unanimously determined that the player had, to the required standard, proved that the citing should be dismissed," the committee said in a statement.

Yato was injured in the incident and went off shortly after scoring a try. Prendergast was not penalised at the time but later cited. The tackle prompted an outburst on Monday from South Africa coach Rassie Erasmus, who predicted Prendergast would get off on "a technicality". Erasmus' comments on the officiating in last Friday's loss to France led to him getting a six-match ban from World Rugby.

FAST

STOCKHOLM, Nov 18 : The 2027 Women's World Cup will kick off a three-year run of major tournaments that could lift players' earnings and create new opportunities for agents, says Maria Karlsson De Cecco, founder of CMG. The Stockholm-based agency, which represents around 100 clients in the women's game – three-quarters of whom are players – is focused on helping its athletes navigate a crucial period. "We now have three years with the World Cup, the Olympics and then the European Championship, so these are three incredibly important years in terms of the careers of our clients, with opportunities for significantly better incomes," she told Reuters in an interview in Stockholm.  "Part of that comes from the prize and compensation money that comes from FIFA or UEFA, but if you perform well during the World Cup, you have every chance of getting a much better contract with your current club or future employer."

For Karlsson De Cecco, it's a long way from the first deal she made as a teenager in Gothenburg more than two decades ago, where she was promised 200 Swedish crowns ($19.74) for every game she appeared in, and she welcomes the arrival of more professionalism in the women's game. "When we started our agency in 2015, we were almost too early — in our first years, calls with sporting directors would often be about why they needed to pay an agency fee, to motivate and explain what we do for our clients," she said.  TOP-FLIGHT PROFESSIONAL The former defender and midfielder was one of the first Swedes to sign a professional contract in England's top flight, moving to Doncaster Belles in 2011. Since then, the game's popularity has exploded, with England twice winning the European Championship and more and more cash flowing into the sport.  FIFA President Gianni Infantino said in 2023 that the governing body had a goal of paying equal World Cup prize money to both men and women, and the details for the 2027 event are to be thrashed out at the governing body's next council meeting in December.  "Two things will make women's football grow much faster in the coming years, and that is prize and compensation money from FIFA and the confederations, and transfer fees," Karlsson De Cecco said. "If the English Football Association, the German Football Association, the Swedish Football Association all receive the same amount of compensation for their women's national team as for their men's national team when they participate in the World Cup, then the associations will invest much more at the grassroots level and at the very top. "As we have seen in recent years, I also think it is crucial that clubs actually pay a little more than they intended for a player, because then you see that it is an investment, and you will have a return on that investment." That rapid development of the women's game is likely to continue through the 2027 World Cup and beyond, Karlsson De Cecco said.   "It is the fastest-growing sport in the world right now, and I don't see anything stopping it." ($1 = 10.1337 Swedish crowns)

Source: Reuters

FAST

ROME, Nov 18 : A bid for Italy's Avio by Finnish satellite operator Iceye drew a cool initial response from the Italian government, with the defence minister urging state-controlled Leonardo to "think carefully" before selling its stake in the company. On Tuesday Iceye made a €2 billion ($2.2 billion) cash offer for Avio, with the goal of creating an integrated European space and defence group. Defence and aerospace group Leonardo holds a stake of 18 per cent in the rocket maker. The deal, part of a drive to boost European defence integration and reduce reliance on external providers such as Elon Musk's Starshield, will need a green light from the Italian government under its golden power rules to shield strategic assets. However, it remains to be seen whether and under what conditions Rome would clear the operation, as defence-related groups are seen as key to national interest by Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni, who in the past has imposed tight limits on such deals.
